title: paeonia foemina subsp. humilis
intro: Paeonia foemina subsp. humilis, commonly known as the dwarf pink peony, is a subspecies of the Paeonia foemina plant, a type of flowering plant native to Europe and Asia. The dwarf pink peony has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antispasmodic properties. The therapeutic actions of Paeonia foemina subsp. humilis include soothing muscle spasms, reducing fever, and alleviating menstrual cramps. Its bioactive constituents include alkaloids, flavonoids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
